Question: At what price must the company offer to repurchase the senior notes on a change of control?

Answer: The company will be required, unless certain conditions are met, to offer to repurchase the Senior Notes at a price equal to 101% of the principal amount of the Senior Notes, plus accrued and unpaid interest and Additional Interest [boyd10k; Item 7; p. 39; c0451].
Specifically, for the 4.750% Senior Notes due 2031, the company will be required to offer to repurchase at a price equal to 101% of the principal amount of the notes, plus any accrued and unpaid interest and Additional Interest [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 77; c0848].
Similarly, for the 4.750% Senior Notes due 2027, the company will be required to offer to repurchase at a price equal to 101% of the principal amount of the notes, plus accrued and unpaid interest and Additional Interest [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 77; c0855].
